keyLimits.en: First-year introductory price $1.89/month, renews at $3.09/month; 1 GB SSD storage, 2 email accounts (1 GB each), 1 database (250 MB), 1 site.
First-year introductory price $3.59/month, renews at $7.09/month; 100 GB SSD storage, 10 email accounts, 5 databases (1 GB each), up to 15 sites.

cautions.en: Listed prices are first-year introductory rates; renewal prices are roughly 1.6x to 2x higher (Starter renews at $3.09 vs $1.89, Personal at $7.09 vs $3.59).
This dossier covers only the 'Personal offer' web hosting range; OVHcloud also sells VPS, Public Cloud (usage-based) and dedicated servers under separate pricing not captured here.

capabilities.en: Shared web hosting with one-click WordPress installation.
Unlimited SSL certificates and unlimited traffic included on hosting plans.
Anti-DDoS protection and automatic backups included.
Free domain name included for the first year.

limitations.en: Entry Starter plan is limited to 1 GB storage and a single site, only suitable for a very small personal site.
99.9% uptime guarantee only, not a higher SLA; higher-availability infrastructure (VPS, Public Cloud, dedicated) is a separate product line with separate pricing.

reason.en: Cloud infrastructure alternative, more developer/VPS-focused than shared hosting.
Alternative for deploying apps closer to compute rather than classic shared hosting.
Alternative for hosting modern web front-ends, though usage-based and not comparable for classic PHP/WordPress hosting.

missingAlternatives.reason: Very common direct competitor for budget shared web hosting, not present in the candidate list.
